---
title: "Budget and Revenue Analysis"
---

```{python}
#| include: false
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

```

This page analyzes the budgets and revenues of the 104 well-known films. @fig-scatter below summarizes and visualizes this relationship.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Scatter plot of budget (x-axis) against revenue (y-axis)"

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (millions of U.S. dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (millions of U.S. dollars)")
plt.show()
```
